assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Image 1 is the approved STYLE and DESIGN REFERENCE, not an edit target. Create ONE standalone production 2D game sprite to reproduce this manual side-sliding infirmary door. Match subdued hand-painted factory game artwork, sage-green aged enamel steel and narrow blue-grey frame, fine dark outlines, pale blue frosted glass, minimal discreet wear. Straight front-facing orthographic game elevation, no isometric rotation or vanishing point. Genuine RGBA transparent background with empty transparent padding, no wall, floor, characters, text, watermark, comparison sheet or surrounding scene. Neutral daylight colors only; night tint will be applied in the game. Asset: ONE LEFT rigid sliding door leaf only. A broad rectangular flat sage-green steel leaf, a single generous horizontally rectangular frosted glass inset in its upper third, solid lower panel, recessed dark vertical handpull near the RIGHT meeting edge at mid height. Thin steel perimeter frame, squared corners, bottom perfectly straight. Two small low roller/hanger mounts integrated at the very top corners only; no long track. Unlike the thin perspective leaves, this is the FULL FRONTAL face of a slab. Production silhouette aspect width:height about 0.9:1 so it fits the game's 90x100 wall face; clean crisp interior details large enough to read at ~90 pixels wide. No angled side, hinge, doorway opening, lock dangling below, protruding pipe, cast shadow extending below or backdrop. Right leaf will be an exact mirrored copy at runtime.
